title: Числа 16 — Numbers 16
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: …they made a conspiracy and rose up against Moses.
cases.explain: The preposition против (against) always takes the genitive → Моисея.

cases.sentence: Пусть каждый возьмёт свой ___, положит в него благовоние.
cases.translation: Let each man take his censer and put incense in it.
cases.explain: Сосуд is the direct object of возьмёт (take); for this inanimate masculine noun the accusative equals the nominative → сосуд.
Благовоние is the direct object of положит (put); for this inanimate neuter noun the accusative equals the nominative → благовоние.

cases.sentence: …встал с Моисеем и ___ у входа в шатёр собрания.
cases.translation: …and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → Аароном.

cases.sentence: …встал с Моисеем и Аароном у ___ в шатёр собрания.
cases.translation: …stood at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at / by) takes the genitive → входа.

cases.sentence: От Господа вышел ___ и сжёг 250 человек.
cases.translation: Fire came out from the Lord and consumed 250 men.
cases.explain: Огонь is the subject that came out and consumed — the doer of the action takes the nominative → огонь.
The preposition в meaning "in" a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → пустыне.

cases.sentence: Скажи ___, отойдите от жилищ Караха, Датана и Авирама.
cases.translation: Tell the people: move away from the dwellings of Korah, Dathan and Abiram.
cases.explain: The dative marks the addressee of сказать ("tell to the people") → народу.

reading.ru: С ними были 250 израилетян, вождей народа, прославленные среди народа знати.
reading.question: How many Israelites joined the rebellion?
reading.explain: The text says 250 Israelites, leaders of the people and renowned men, were with them.

reading.ru: Земля разверзлась и поглотила их и их сородичей.
reading.question: What happened to the rebels and their households?
options: The earth opened and swallowed them
reading.correct: The earth opened and swallowed them
reading.explain: The ground split open and swallowed them together with their kin.

reading.ru: От Господа вышел огонь и сжег 250 человек, которые приносили кадильные благовония.
reading.question: What consumed the 250 men who offered incense?
reading.explain: Fire came out from the Lord and burned the 250 men who were offering incense.

reading.ru: Он встал между мертвыми и живыми, и мор прекратился.
reading.question: What did Aaron do that stopped the plague?
options: He stood between the dead and the living
reading.correct: He stood between the dead and the living
reading.explain: Aaron stood between the dead and the living, and the plague was stopped.

reading.ru: Но четырнадцать тысяч семьсот человек умерло от мора, не считая тех, кто умер из-за караха.
reading.question: How many people died from the plague?
reading.explain: The text states 14,700 people died from the plague, apart from those who died over Korah.

reading.ru: Аарон вернулся к Моисею ко входу в шатер собрания, потому что мор прекратился.
reading.question: Why did Aaron return to Moses at the tent of meeting?
reading.explain: Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance of the tent because the plague had ceased.
